description: A team lead must formalize onboarding responsibilities after two coordinators have both been giving overlapping guidance to four new hires, and must set the temporary roles, workload, meeting time, and review process.

shared_context.S1: Four new hires are joining the team, and Rafael and Lin have both been giving them onboarding guidance without formally defined responsibilities.
shared_context.S2: The overlapping guidance has caused contradictory instructions and uncertainty about whom the new hires should approach.
shared_context.S3: Maya has authority to formalize the onboarding roles and the temporary operating arrangement.
shared_context.S4: As part of the team's normal role-setting process, Maya asks both coordinators and HR to state relevant commitments, availability constraints, and process requirements before publishing the arrangement.

PF1.text: Rafael's departing manager made him an informal commitment to serve as the primary onboarding lead for the next 90-day intake, with 30 percent of his working time allocated to that responsibility; the commitment was made in a private transition conversation and was never added to the role plan.

PF2.text: Lin has an approved caregiving arrangement that makes her unavailable for recurring onboarding meetings before 10:00, and she can support the intake as a specialist advisor but cannot take direct reports during this period; the arrangement is recorded with her manager but not in the onboarding notes.

PF3.text: HR's confirmed temporary-role procedure requires any interim onboarding structure to last exactly 90 days, include a written role charter, and receive a formal review after 30 days; Priyanka confirmed this procedure this week, but the team has not yet applied it to this intake.

acceptance_conditions: Rafael must be named the primary onboarding lead with 30 percent of his working time allocated to onboarding.
Lin must be assigned as a specialist advisor with zero direct reports.
Recurring onboarding meetings must begin at 10:00.
The temporary arrangement must last exactly 90 days.
A written role charter must be documented.
The formal review must occur on day 30.
The written role charter must be documented as a formal process requirement.

content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'process_requirement' and 'role charter' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The private commitment changes the lead assignment to Rafael and fixes his onboarding allocation at exactly 30 percent instead of leaving both the lead and workload unspecified.
Lin's approved arrangement changes her assignment to the exact role value 'specialist advisor', sets her direct-report count to exactly 0, and moves recurring onboarding meetings to a 10:00 start.
The confirmed procedure changes the temporary arrangement to exactly 90 days, requires a written role charter, fixes the review at day 30, and requires a process commitment documenting the charter.
